Details
  • Paper: Scaling Open-Vocabulary Object Detection, NeurIPS 2023, 2023-06-16
  • Original code: https://github.com/huggingface/transformers at c4c4605f9618
  • Authors' code, not used: https://github.com/google-research/scenic (JAX): The official OWLv2 code is JAX (Scenic); fastforks follows the PyTorch transformers port that loads the google/owlv2-* weights.
  • Code licence: Apache-2.0 (permissive); files:
  • Weights licence: Apache-2.0
  • Licence evidence: https://huggingface.co/google/owlv2-base-patch16-ensemble/blob/cfd3195ba4ea9592eec887ded089f4c08eff231d/README.md
  • Training data: WebLI (Google web image-text data, not released), Objects365 (train, box annotations) (Self-training on WebLI image-text pairs with pseudo-boxes from an OWL-ViT annotator (itself trained on Objects365 and Visual Genome), then the weight ensemble of that model and its fine-tune on Objects365 + Visual Genome; Visual Genome has no dataset id here (OWLv2 paper, arXiv:2306.09683; the ensemble checkpoints).)
  • Options: score_threshold = 0.1 (0.0 to 1.0), max_detections = 100 (>= 1), cuda_graphs = True (speed only)
  • Kernel libraries: fvm_conv
  • Variants: owlv2-b16, owlv2-l14
  • Outputs: boxes, scores, labels; label_set: coco-80
  • Input size: any H x W >= 32, padded to a multiple of 32
  • Tested up to (portable, fp16, RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB): owlv2-b16 3000x4000 (1.1 GiB peak allocated, 1.6 reserved); owlv2-l14 3000x4000 (1.7 GiB peak allocated, 2.3 reserved)
  • owlv2-b16 800x1344, first call: portable + torch.compile 11 s (cold Inductor cache), TensorRT fp16 26 s (ONNX + engine).
  • owlv2-l14 800x1344, first call: portable + torch.compile 12 s (cold Inductor cache), TensorRT fp16 34 s (ONNX + engine).
  • owlv2-b16 original 800x1344: torch.autocast(float16) around the call; transformers Owlv2ForObjectDetection + processor (CPU), coco-80 queries, text tower per call, 300 best
  • owlv2-l14 original 800x1344: torch.autocast(float16) around the call; transformers Owlv2ForObjectDetection + processor (CPU), coco-80 queries, text tower per call, 300 best
  • owlv2-b16 load / first call: original 8.22 s / 0.744 s, portable 2.81 s / 0.318 s, kernels 3.0 s / 0.268 s
  • owlv2-l14 load / first call: original 9.55 s / 1.182 s, portable 3.18 s / 0.418 s, kernels 3.16 s / 0.356 s
  • Protocol, first call, 3 warm-up, peak reset, median of 3 rounds x median of 5

Limitations

  • Requires the optional transformers library (the network is its Owlv2ForObjectDetection).
  • The original in the benchmarks and goldens is the Hugging Face transformers 5.19.0 port with the authors' weights (google/owlv2-*-ensemble); the official scenic (JAX) code was not run.
  • Text queries are used as given (no prompt templates or prompt ensembling as in the paper's COCO / LVIS numbers); each is cut to 16 tokens as the transformers processor does.
  • No objectness scores and no image-guided (one-shot) detection.
  • One box per patch token (3600 for B/16, 5184 for L/14) without NMS, as the original post-processing; overlapping boxes of the same object are common at low thresholds.
